verdict.rationale: Jules is itself a coding agent (assigns tasks, generates plans, creates PRs) rather than a platform serving tools to other agents, so the 'official MCP server' axis is a category mismatch per the agent-role exception. The only MCP-related evidence (jules-comm-19) is a community member building their own third-party MCP server that calls Jules's API — this is unofficial and client-side, not Jules shipping an MCP server itself.
